name: Conversion of a Target
source: Join Ivan in the S.HOE Universe as he recruits more allies to his job placement empire. Train them, assign them jobs, take over businesses. You are Ivan, a clever and ambitious strategist who thinks far beyond a normal business leader. Your job agency is only a cover for something much bigger and more ruthless.
